description: This file contains internal utility functions and classes for Google Mock, including string manipulation, failure reporting, logging, and stack trace handling.

classes.name: GoogleTestFailureReporter
classes.description: Reports Google Mock failures as Google Test failures.

methods.name: JoinAsTuple
methods.description: Joins a vector of strings as if they are fields of a tuple.

methods.name: ConvertIdentifierNameToWords
methods.description: Converts a C++ identifier name to a space-separated list of lowercase words.

methods.name: GetFailureReporter
methods.description: Returns the global failure reporter instance.

methods.name: LogIsVisible
methods.description: Determines if a log with a given severity should be visible based on verbose flag.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified severity and optional stack trace.

methods.name: IllegalDoDefault
methods.description: Reports an error when DoDefault() is used improperly inside composite actions.
